summary.repoIntent: WakePoint (Flutter package geowake2) is a metro/transit wake-up alarm that reliably fires an alarm as a rider approaches their destination station, transfer point, or mode-change — even in tunnels and deep-metro segments where GPS is degraded or absent. It fuses live GPS with a route-constrained 1-D Extended Kalman Filter for dead-reckoning, snaps position onto Google Directions routes, and evaluates geometric per-leg alarm triggers delivered through Android/iOS full-screen notifications that survive app-swipe on a separate background isolate. A thin Node/Express backend proxies all Google Maps calls so the API key never ships on the device. Developer web dashboards and a mocking-free test suite exercise the whole pipeline deterministically over synthetic GPS/IMU inputs and time-warped virtual time.
summary.northStar: Wake the rider at the right station — reliably, even underground with no GPS.

nodes.label: App Foundation & Configuration
nodes.purpose: The bootstrap layer plus the shared leaf primitives and centralized tuning constants the rest of the app builds on: the process entry point that boots Hive and mounts MaterialApp with the route table and theme toggle, the AppClock time abstraction for accelerated simulation, shared value types, the generated all-India station dataset and metro colors, and the feature-flag/threshold/power-profile config layer.

nodes.label: Backend API Gateway
nodes.purpose: The geowake-server Node/Express backend is a thin, stateless API gateway between the Flutter app and the Google Maps Platform whose whole reason to exist is to keep the Maps API key off the device. The phone authenticates with a device JWT and the server proxies Directions/Autocomplete/Place-Details/Geocoding/Nearby-Search calls, injecting the secret key server-side, caching responses, and enforcing rate limiting.

nodes.label: Sensor Fusion & Dead-Reckoning (EKF)
nodes.purpose: A route-constrained Extended Kalman Filter that provides dead-reckoning position along a known transit polyline when GPS is degraded or absent (tunnels, deep-metro), so the wake-up alarm still fires at the right station without a satellite fix. It is a 1-D filter on route arc-length s (not 2-D lat/lng), fusing IMU forward-acceleration with route-projected GPS, ZUPT, and station-snap corrections.

nodes.label: Live Tracking Runtime (Background Service)
nodes.purpose: The live-tracking hub that turns a GPS position stream into route progress, ETA, and ultimately the wake-up alarm while surviving app-swipe and process death on a separate background isolate. TrackingService is a singleton facade spanning foreground and background isolates, owning the position loop, alarm evaluation, notification/dashboard sync, and cross-isolate state persistence.

nodes.label: Platform, Connectivity & Sensor Bridge
nodes.purpose: The edge layer of lib/services that talks to the network, OS, sensors, and simulation harness: the backend HTTP gateway, Places/metro-stop clients, the EKF sensor-fusion bridge, the WebSocket simulation feed, permission prompts, GPS-health observation, and an offline OSM road-graph + A* pathfinder used only by the deviation dashboards.

nodes.label: Quality, Simulation & Test Infrastructure
nodes.purpose: The non-shipping developer/QA and verification layer: Flutter-web dashboards that simulate GPS movement, route deviations, EKF replay, and time-warp without walking a real route, plus a mocking-free test suite that drives real production objects through static test seams over synthetic GPS/IMU inputs. The ConstraintLogger event bus is shared with production deviation/reroute code, so the unit is not fully isolated from shipping code.

nodes.label: Routing & Route Sessions
nodes.purpose: Turns a Google Directions response into the canonical route model the whole app tracks against: cached directions, per-leg transit stop geometry, transfer/mode-change event boundaries, step distance+duration boundaries for ETA, and a live active-route state with automatic route switching. TransferUtils is the pure-function toolbox (top fan-in hub) every alarm/tracking consumer imports.

nodes.label: User-Facing App Screens
nodes.purpose: The end-user Flutter screen layer that owns the full foreground UX flow: a launch splash that restores or resets a tracking session, a home screen to search a destination and configure the alarm (distance/time/stops + metro mode), a transient map-warmup buffer, and a live map-tracking screen rendering route/ETA/transfer notices and the STOP ALARM / END TRACKING controls. Pure presentation that wires user intent into services and consumes their streams.

nodes.label: Wake-Up Alarm Engine
nodes.purpose: The decision-and-delivery core of the wake-up alarm. A stateless geometric state machine decides WHEN to fire per route leg (stops/time/distance thresholds), classifies the trigger (destination/transfer/mode_change/final_station/preBoarding) and builds the user-facing message; NotificationService presents and persists the Android/iOS alarm and brokers user actions across isolates.

nodes.label: Process bootstrap and theming
nodes.purpose: The main() entry point, MaterialApp/route table/theme toggle and lifecycle flush, Material3 light/dark themes, and the shared loading widget.

nodes.label: Station dataset and metro colors
nodes.purpose: The generated all-India metro station records and the metro line color map consumed across routing, transfer parsing, and dashboards.

nodes.label: Time abstraction and shared models
nodes.purpose: AppClock real-vs-warped virtual time driving ETA/alarm/deviation timing, plus the shared RouteModel/TransitSwitch value types.

nodes.label: Tuning constants and feature flags
nodes.purpose: Centralized deviation/reroute/termination thresholds, battery-tier GPS/power profiles, the simulation-bridge gate, and canonical server/bundle-id constants.

nodes.label: Device token minting and verification
nodes.purpose: Mints short-lived device JWTs for clients presenting the correct bundle id and verifies Bearer tokens on protected routes.

nodes.label: Google Maps proxy and caching
nodes.purpose: The googleApiProxy that checks cache, calls Google with the injected key, caches by structured type+params key with per-type TTLs, and returns Google's raw envelope.

nodes.label: App composition, config, and rate limiting
nodes.purpose: Composes the Express app (security headers, CORS, compression, error handlers, graceful shutdown), holds central env-validated config, and enforces per-route rate limiting and slow-down.

nodes.label: EKF math pipeline and orchestration
nodes.purpose: The 3-state [s,v,b] filter with 3x3 covariance and predict/GPS-update/ZUPT/station-snap steps, plus the orchestrator that wires all sensor stages around it and owns the snap gate.

nodes.label: Motion classification, tilt, and degraded/tunnel mode
nodes.purpose: Estimates gravity/device rotation for forward-acceleration, classifies motion state, and detects GPS degradation to enter/exit bounded dead-reckoning mode.

nodes.label: Route geometry and arc-length projection
nodes.purpose: Projects 2-D GPS to 1-D route arc-length meters and back (projectLatLng/tangentAt/positionAt), the bridge between the map and the filter.

nodes.label: Station association and offline replay harness
nodes.purpose: Selects a single station within the 3-sigma window on ZUPT for gated station snaps, and provides the deterministic log/replay engine used by dashboards and integration tests.

nodes.label: Runtime alarm decision and dedup
nodes.purpose: The sole runtime orchestrator that builds leg context, calls the evaluator, owns per-leg fired-state dedup, cooldown suppression, and migrateAlarmState across route switches.

nodes.label: Foreground/background isolate bridge
nodes.purpose: Bridges UI and background isolates via ack-retried invokes, stream piping, and heartbeat, and registers the background service message listeners.

nodes.label: Background GPS position loop and source
nodes.purpose: Owns the position loop that computes ETA, tracks movement, ingests position into the route session, runs EKF for dropout, and drives the alarm check; sources raw positions from Geolocator or the simulation client.

nodes.label: Cross-isolate state persistence and notification sync
nodes.purpose: Persists and rehydrates session flags and snapshots across isolates and process death, and keeps the foreground notification and debug dashboard in sync.

nodes.label: Backend HTTP gateway client
nodes.purpose: The singleton HTTP gateway to the geowake backend with Bearer-token auth, auto-refresh on 401, and test-mode canned responses; every Google Maps call routes through it.

nodes.label: Places, metro-stop lookup, and permissions
nodes.purpose: Autocomplete/place-details, nearby transit-station lookup and metro-destination validation, and OS permission prompts feeding the home screen.

nodes.label: EKF sensor-fusion bridge and GPS health
nodes.purpose: Wraps the core/ekf orchestrator, ingesting IMU + GPS and emitting EKF state and station-snap events; includes GPS-health observation scaffolding.

nodes.label: Simulation feed and offline OSM routing
nodes.purpose: Streams simulated positions over a WebSocket relay and provides the offline OSM road-graph and A* pathfinder used by deviation dashboards.

nodes.label: Constraint event bus
nodes.purpose: The singleton typed event bus consumed by dashboards and written by production deviation/reroute services; its API is shipping-code-load-bearing.

nodes.label: Deterministic test harness
nodes.purpose: Shared test infrastructure (global Hive setup, fake GPS streaming) plus representative alarm/EKF/device integration suites driving production objects over synthetic inputs.

nodes.label: EKF replay QA panel
nodes.purpose: The EKF route-replay panel driving recorded IMU/route data with GPS-dropout toggles through the real tracking service.

nodes.label: GPS deviation simulation dashboards
nodes.purpose: The primary dev/QA dashboard and simulation engine that computes deviation/return paths over OSM pathfinding, enforce a validated lifecycle state machine, and expose global time-warp control.

nodes.label: Active-route snapping and switching
nodes.purpose: Continuously snaps the user to the active route and applies hysteretic multi-route switching, emitting ActiveRouteState/RouteSwitchEvent and the EKF station-snap monotonic gate.

nodes.label: Directions fetch, caching, and logging
nodes.purpose: Fetches driving/transit directions with tiered in-memory + Hive caching and metro-preference fallback, builds segmented polylines, and logs raw responses for offline reconstruction.

nodes.label: Multi-route session orchestration
nodes.purpose: Owns the registry and all per-route *ByKey state, orchestrates deviation/reroute/soft-lock, and provides the two route-registration intake paths.

nodes.label: Transit geometry, boundaries, and ETA math
nodes.purpose: Parses raw Directions JSON into leg stops, events, and cumulative meter boundaries, simplifies/compresses polylines, and interpolates ETA-remaining/to-target.

nodes.label: Destination search and alarm configuration
nodes.purpose: Destination autocomplete/map-tap selection, alarm-mode UI, permission gating, route fetch and validation, snapshot persistence, and startTracking; backed by Hive recent destinations.

nodes.label: Live map tracking UI
nodes.purpose: Renders map markers/polylines, snaps live GPS, computes/formats ETA and remaining distance, shows transfer banners, and exposes the STOP ALARM / END TRACKING controls.

nodes.label: Splash and map-warmup navigation
nodes.purpose: Initializes ApiClient/NotificationService/TrackingService, decides restore-vs-home, and warms a GoogleMap instance before handing off to tracking.

nodes.label: Settings drawer and ringtones
nodes.purpose: Shared side drawer for theme toggle and preboarding/destination-only alarm flags, and the alarm-tone picker with preview persisted to preferences.

nodes.label: Geometric alarm decision state machine
nodes.purpose: evaluateCoinciding decides per-leg firing and classifies the event; estimateEtaSecondsToMeters powers time-mode; defines the AlarmTrigger/AlarmMode/AlarmEventType contract.

nodes.label: Notification, sound, and haptics delivery
nodes.purpose: Presents/cancels the full-screen alarm, progress, and paused notifications, drives sound and vibration, and routes notification-button actions across the plugin background isolate.

nodes.label: Pre-trip stops-threshold validation
nodes.purpose: Validates whether a chosen stops threshold is achievable for the route and per-metro-leg stop counts before tracking begins (not in the runtime firing path).
